pages.summary: The add-ons the theme works with: whether each one is installed, what it shows in the theme and where to set it.

pages.title: Performance
pages.summary: What makes the theme heavy on the graphics card, and Playnite's own settings that conflict with it.

pages.title: Profile
pages.summary: Profiles, sharing, backups, reset and diagnostics.
